name: Gemma
alibi: Spotted fleeing a flat in Cluny Mews.
bio: SUBJECT: Gemma, a quiet operator with a perfect alibi rehearsed too many times. LAST SEEN: Cluny Mews at first light. KNOWN ASSOCIATES: Nobody listed, which makes the empty file louder.

name: Brendan Alper
alibi: Laying low since his Canterbury Academy days.
trait: has a narrow nose and moustache
bio: SUBJECT: Brendan Alper, polished manners and an unfinished debt. LAST SEEN: A Canterbury tea room after closing. KNOWN ASSOCIATES: Former academy men who deny everything.

name: Kyle Tucker
alibi: Smuggled in on a freighter from Bermuda.
bio: SUBJECT: Kyle Tucker, dockside muscle with salt still on his coat. LAST SEEN: Pier Nine, watching the tide. KNOWN ASSOCIATES: The Bermuda freight crew.

name: James Kirimi
alibi: Mastermind behind the UK transport operations.
trait: has a long jaw and angular glasses
bio: SUBJECT: James Kirimi, a logistics man who knows every route but his own. LAST SEEN: The control room. KNOWN ASSOCIATES: Drivers who speak only in timetables.

name: Stanley
alibi: Overheard plotting at a dinner gathering.
trait: has bushy brows and a cleft chin
bio: SUBJECT: Stanley, a dinner guest who stayed after the lights went out. LAST SEEN: The private dining room. KNOWN ASSOCIATES: A table of nervous witnesses.

name: Mama
alibi: The undisputed matriarch of the syndicate.
trait: wears a cloche hat and pearl pin
bio: SUBJECT: Mama, the voice every room falls silent to hear. LAST SEEN: At the head of the syndicate table. KNOWN ASSOCIATES: Everyone, officially no one.

name: Marley
trait: has pointed ears and whisker marks
bio: SUBJECT: Marley, a tiny specialist in impossible entry points. LAST SEEN: A rooftop ledge above Cluny Mews. KNOWN ASSOCIATES: Dilly, usually one step behind.

name: Dilly
trait: has floppy ears and a broad nose
bio: SUBJECT: Dilly, the lookout with a habit of humming at crime scenes. LAST SEEN: Near the service alley. KNOWN ASSOCIATES: Marley, their partner in every caper.
